input.command: gh pr merge https://github.com/aml11/oked-app/pull/124 --squash 2>&1 | tail -1; SHA=$(gh pr view https://github.com/aml11/oked-app/pull/124 --json state,mergeCommit --jq '.mergeCommit.oid'); echo "merged ${SHA:0:7}"; end=$(( $(date +%s) + 900 )); while [ $(date +%s) -lt $end ]; do v=$(curl -s --max-time 10 https://api.oked.ai/health | jq -r .version 2>/dev/null); [ "$v" = "$SHA" ] && { echo "deployed at $(date +%H:%M:%S)"; break; }; sleep 15; done; curl -s https://api.oked.ai/health; echo; curl -s -w " %{http_code}\n" -X POST https://api.oked.ai/api/mobile/v1/auth/token -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"grant_type":"qr","token":"nope"}'
